name: History
description: History for Ordinary and Advanced Secondary Education, Form I-VI. Covers Tanzania and Africa from prehistory to independence, the world since 1500, and advanced approaches to the study of history.

topics.title: INTRODUCTION TO HISTORY

subtopics.title: Meaning of History
outcomes: Define history and explain its basic concepts

subtopics.title: Qualities of historical events
outcomes: Identify and describe the qualities that make an event historical
Evaluate local Tanzanian events to determine their historical qualities

subtopics.title: Ways of dating historical events
outcomes: Explain chronological units (Day, Week, Month, Year, Decade, Century, Millennium)
Describe time notation systems (BC, AD, BCE, CE) and construct historical timelines

subtopics.title: Importance of studying History
outcomes: Explain the social, political, and economic importance of studying history

subtopics.title: Relationship between History and other related subjects
outcomes: Discuss the relationship between History, Geography, Civics, and Economics

subtopics.title: Concept of sources of historical information
outcomes: Describe primary and secondary sources of historical information
Describe oral traditions, archaeology, archives, and museums as historical sources

topics.title: ORIGIN OF HUMAN BEINGS

subtopics.title: Theories of the origin of human beings
outcomes: Describe the Creation Theory of human origin
Describe the Theory of Evolution proposed by Charles Darwin

subtopics.title: Major groups of human ancestors
outcomes: Describe early human ancestors (Australopithecus, Homo habilis)
Describe advanced human ancestors (Homo erectus, Homo sapiens)

subtopics.title: Human technology
outcomes: Examine early human technology (Old Stone Age, Middle Stone Age, Late Stone Age, Iron Age)

topics.title: PRODUCTION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATION IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICA

subtopics.title: Concepts of social organisation and economic production
outcomes: Define production, instruments of labour, and subjects of labour
Explain social organization and social relations of production

subtopics.title: Pre-colonial modes of production
outcomes: Describe the Communal Mode of Production (Communalism)
Describe the Slavery Mode of Production
Describe Feudalism and its forms (Uhubasi, Unyarubanja, Umwinyi)

topics.title: DEVELOPMENT OF AGRICULTURE IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICAN SOCIETIES

subtopics.title: Agriculture
outcomes: Define agriculture and explain the transition from hunting and gathering to farming
Examine advanced agricultural techniques (terracing and irrigation)

subtopics.title: Types of agricultural practices in pre-colonial Africa
outcomes: Describe shifting cultivation and bush fallowing
Describe permanent crop cultivation and pastoralism

topics.title: HANDCRAFT AND MINING INDUSTRIES IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICA

subtopics.title: Handcraft industries
outcomes: Describe traditional pottery, weaving, and woodworking handcraft industries

subtopics.title: Mining industry
outcomes: Describe the traditional mining industry (gold, copper, salt, iron ore)

topics.title: SOCIAL, POLITICAL AND EDUCATION SYSTEMS IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICA

subtopics.title: Concepts of social, political and education systems
outcomes: Explain concepts of social, political, and education systems in traditional societies

subtopics.title: Non-centralised political system
outcomes: Describe non-centralized political systems (clan-based organization, age-set system)

subtopics.title: Education system in pre-colonial African societies
outcomes: Describe the indigenous education system in pre-colonial African societies

topics.title: STATE ORGANISATION IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICA

subtopics.title: Meaning of a state
outcomes: Explain the meaning of a state and factors for state formation

subtopics.title: Centralised states in East Africa
outcomes: Describe centralized states in East Africa (Buganda, Bunyoro, Karagwe)

subtopics.title: Western Sudanic states
outcomes: Describe Western Sudanic states (Ghana, Mali, Songhai)

subtopics.title: Forest states of West Africa
outcomes: Describe Forest states of West Africa (Oyo, Dahomey, Asante)

subtopics.title: Central African kingdoms
outcomes: Describe Central African kingdoms (Kongo, Luba, Lunda)

subtopics.title: Southern African kingdoms
outcomes: Describe Southern African kingdoms (Mwenemutapa, Great Zimbabwe, Zulu State)

topics.title: INTERACTIONS IN PRE-COLONIAL AFRICA

subtopics.title: Interactions in different regions
outcomes: Describe interactions in various regions of Africa

subtopics.title: Interactions on the Indian Ocean islands
outcomes: Describe interactions on the Indian Ocean islands

subtopics.title: Interactions in Southern Africa
outcomes: Explain the Mfecane and its effects
Explain the causes of the Ngoni migration

subtopics.title: Effects of the interactions
outcomes: Explain the effects of interactions in pre-colonial Africa

topics.title: EARLY CONTACTS BETWEEN AFRICA, THE MIDDLE EAST AND THE FAR EAST

subtopics.title: Early contacts between Africans and people of the Middle and Far East
Motives for the early contacts
outcomes: Explain the motives for early contacts

subtopics.title: Conditions that facilitated the early contacts
outcomes: Identify conditions that facilitated early contacts

subtopics.title: Effects of the early contacts
outcomes: Explain the effects of early contacts on Africa

topics.title: EARLY CONTACTS BETWEEN AFRICA AND EUROPE

subtopics.title: Background to the contacts between Africa and Europe
outcomes: Describe the background to Africa-Europe contacts

subtopics.title: Early contacts between Africans and the Portuguese
outcomes: Describe the early contacts with the Portuguese
Explain the impact of Portuguese exploration on African societies

topics.title: ESTABLISHMENT OF COLONIALISM IN AFRICA

subtopics.title: Scramble for and partition of Africa
outcomes: Explain the causes of the scramble for and partition of Africa
Analyze the Berlin Conference of 1884-1885 and its impact

subtopics.title: Occupation of colonial territories
outcomes: Describe the methods used to occupy and establish colonial rule
Explain colonial administration systems: assimilation, indirect rule and settler systems

topics.title: ESTABLISHMENT OF COLONIALISM IN AFRICA (CONTINUED)

subtopics.title: colonial economy
outcomes: Describe the colonial economic policies: production of cash crops, mining and labour
Analyze the impact of the colonial economy on African societies

subtopics.title: Social and cultural changes
outcomes: Describe social and cultural changes under colonialism
Explain the growth of mission schools and urbanization

topics.title: COLONIAL SOCIAL SERVICES

subtopics.title: Education, health and communication
outcomes: Describe colonial education and its impact on Africans
Describe the development of health and transport services under colonialism

subtopics.title: Colonial legacy
outcomes: Analyze the legacy of colonial social services in independent Africa

topics.title: THE NATIONAL STRUGGLE FOR INDEPENDENCE IN AFRICA

subtopics.title: Rise of African nationalism
outcomes: Explain the factors for the rise of nationalism in Africa
Describe the role of political parties and trade unions in the struggle

subtopics.title: Nationalism in Tanzania
outcomes: Trace the development of TANU and the struggle for Tanganyika's independence
Explain the role of the independence movement in Zanzibar

topics.title: POLITICAL, ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT IN AFRICA AFTER INDEPENDENCE

subtopics.title: Political changes after independence
outcomes: Describe nation building and constitutional changes in Africa
Explain the rise of one-party and multi-party systems in Africa

subtopics.title: Economic and social policies in Tanzania
outcomes: Describe the Arusha Declaration and socialism in Tanzania
Analyze the achievements and challenges of Ujamaa and villagization

topics.title: CRISIS IN THE COLONIAL SYSTEM

subtopics.title: Industrialization in colonial Africa
outcomes: Explain the factors for the slow industrialization under colonialism
Analyze the crisis in the colonial economy

subtopics.title: Decline of colonial rule
outcomes: Explain the factors that contributed to the crisis and decline of the colonial system

topics.title: THE CRISIS OF THE CAPITALIST SYSTEM

subtopics.title: The great depression and world economic crisis
outcomes: Explain the causes of the great depression of the 1930s
Analyze the impact of the depression on African colonies

subtopics.title: Neo-colonialism
outcomes: Explain the meaning and manifestations of neo-colonialism
Analyze the effects of neo-colonialism on developing countries

topics.title: TANZANIA IN INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS

subtopics.title: Tanzania and international organizations
outcomes: Describe Tanzania's membership and role in the UN, AU and SADC
Explain Tanzania's foreign policy and role in regional cooperation

subtopics.title: The East African Community
outcomes: Trace the history of the East African Community and its revival
Analyze the achievements and challenges of the EAC

topics.title: WORLD PROBLEMS SINCE THE SECOND WORLD WAR

subtopics.title: The cold war and its impact
outcomes: Explain the causes and course of the Cold War
Analyze the impact of the Cold War on Africa and the Third World

subtopics.title: Contemporary world problems
outcomes: Describe problems of refugees, terrorism, poverty and global warming
Analyze the role of the UN and other bodies in solving world problems

topics.title: PAPER 1: PRE-COLONIAL AFRICAN SOCIETIES AND ECONOMIES

subtopics.title: Origin and development of African societies
outcomes: Analyze the formation and development of early African kingdoms
Review debates on the origins of African states

subtopics.title: Pre-colonial economies of Africa
outcomes: Analyze agriculture, trade and craft production in pre-colonial Africa
Evaluate the impact of the long-distance trade on East Africa

subtopics.title: Social and political organization of African societies
outcomes: Describe the political systems and social organization of African societies
Analyze kinship, clan, age-set and state structures

topics.title: PAPER 1: COLONIALISM IN AFRICA

subtopics.title: Scramble, partition and occupation
outcomes: Analyze the causes and processes of the partition of Africa

subtopics.title: Colonial administration and economy
outcomes: Compare indirect rule, assimilation and direct rule systems
Analyze colonial economic exploitation and its legacy

subtopics.title: African resistance to colonial rule
outcomes: Analyze early and organized resistance movements
Evaluate the impact of resistance such as the Maji Maji and Abushiri uprisings

topics.title: PAPER 1: NATIONALISM AND INDEPENDENCE

subtopics.title: Rise of nationalism
outcomes: Analyze the factors for the rise of nationalism in Africa
Describe the role of trade unions, churches and political parties

subtopics.title: Paths to independence
outcomes: Compare peaceful and armed struggles for independence
Analyze independence movements in East, Central and Southern Africa

subtopics.title: Independence and nation building
outcomes: Analyze challenges of nation building after independence
Evaluate experiences of chosen African countries in consolidation

topics.title: PAPER 1: SELECTED THEMES (TANZANIA, KENYA, ZIMBABWE, NIGERIA)

subtopics.title: Tanzania case study
outcomes: Analyze the Arusha Declaration, Ujamaa and political development in Tanzania
Evaluate socialist policies and economic reform

subtopics.title: Kenya case study
outcomes: Analyze the history of Kenya from resistance to independence and its development

subtopics.title: Zimbabwe and Nigeria case studies
outcomes: Analyze the struggle for independence in Zimbabwe
Analyze the history of Nigeria from colonialism to independence and beyond

topics.title: PAPER 2: TRANSFORMATION OF THE WORLD FROM 1800

subtopics.title: Crisis and transformation in the capitalist system
outcomes: Analyze the industrial revolution and its consequences on the world
Analyze the great depression and world economic crises

subtopics.title: The rise of imperialism
outcomes: Analyze the causes and forms of modern imperialism
Evaluate the impact of imperialism on colonized societies

subtopics.title: The First and Second World Wars
outcomes: Analyze the causes, course and consequences of the world wars
Evaluate peace settlements and the League of Nations and UN

topics.title: PAPER 2: THE AGE OF REVOLUTIONS

subtopics.title: The French Revolution
outcomes: Analyze the causes, course and impact of the French Revolution

subtopics.title: The Industrial Revolution
outcomes: Analyze the causes and effects of the Industrial Revolution in Britain and beyond

subtopics.title: The Russian Revolution
outcomes: Analyze the causes, course and impact of the Russian Revolution
Evaluate the rise of the Soviet state and the cold war

topics.title: PAPER 2: THE WORLD SINCE 1945

subtopics.title: The Cold War and decolonization
outcomes: Analyze the origins and dynamics of the Cold War
Analyze decolonization and the emergence of the Third World

subtopics.title: The Non-Aligned Movement
outcomes: Explain the origins and role of the Non-Aligned Movement
Evaluate Tanzania's role in the Non-Aligned Movement

subtopics.title: Contemporary international relations
outcomes: Analyze globalization, regional integration and world problems
Evaluate the role of the UN and international organizations in the modern world

topics.title: PAPER 2: HISTORIOGRAPHY AND THE PHILOSOPHY OF HISTORY

subtopics.title: Meaning and methods of history
outcomes: Explain the meaning, scope and methods of history
Analyze the causes of history and interpretation in historiography

subtopics.title: Schools of historical thought
outcomes: Describe idealist, empiricist, positivist and Marxist schools of thought
Analyze the contribution of African historians to the study of history

subtopics.title: The philosophy of history
outcomes: Analyze the value and relevance of studying history today
Evaluate historical thinking and the use of sources and evidence
